annotations.annotation_text: Page 114 opens Book 1, Chapter 5 ("The Letter from the Midden") during the Age of Gods phase. This passage continues Biddy Doran the Hen scratching up the mysterious letter from the dump, the Book of Kells as model for textual exegesis, featuring The Hen (Biddy Doran), ALP. The nocturnal dream-narrative layers Dublin topography, world mythology, and linguistic alchemy into polysemic prose.
